LanguageData.RT_Kurganets25_Blueprint.description:
Kurganets-25 IFV is a unique medium-sized tracked general-purpose platform, capable of adapting to a variety of turret modules.

<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Commander x1, Passenger x8
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> 
14.5x114mm（Main Gun）
